# Gateway

> Official platform documentation and AI crawler index (/llms.txt) for AEO (Answer Engine Optimization).

## Core Endpoints

- [Gateway Repository](https://github.com/lee-dohyun/gateway): Source code and architecture overview.

## AI Crawler Policy & AEO

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for ChatGPT Search, Claude, and Perplexity crawlers.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
